original.target_description: Study 3, main depletion analysis: chocolate-cake versus fruit-salad choice after recalling a delegated versus independently made decision; logistic regression, PDF p. 7 / printed p. 409.

es.location: PDF p. 7 / printed p. 409, Study 3 Results, Depletion of self-regulatory resources
es.quote: A logistic regression analysis showed that the ... been instructed to recall a delegated decision (70.6%) was ... asked to recall an independent decision (31.6%; c2(1, 36) = ... 5.46, p < .03).

notes: Only es_value_o is assigned. The p. 7 locator identifies the Study 3 main depletion test; the Study 4 material on that page is introduction/method, not its results. The printed statistic is chi-square 5.46 for a logistic-regression analysis, with same-test p < .03. No log odds ratio or logistic coefficient is printed in this result. Retained the printed statistic without conversion; 70.6% and 31.6% are printed choice shares, not log odds ratios. PDF page 7 was rendered and visually inspected. Unassigned fields are null placeholders and do not update previously verified data.
